claude.note: The native harness: Claude Code has no command that lists models, so this is captured by hand from claude --help. Its --model takes an alias for the latest model of a line or a model's full name (the help gives the aliases fable, opus and sonnet as examples; haiku is the alias Aether's agents already use) and its --effort takes low, medium, high, xhigh and max. Each id is the Claude API id the alias resolves to.

models.excluded: The owner keeps Fable out until Fable 5.5 (decision A43).

grok.note: grok --help lists --reasoning-effort without its values; these four are the levels Aether uses, not a list the CLI printed

muse.note: model/list of muse serve 1.4.10, asked over MSP with the owner's login and no model call: source bundledCatalog, one model, which is also the session's default. Its reasoningEffortVariants are minimal, low, medium, high and xhigh, with no max. Meta documents muse-spark-1.3 and muse-wonder-1.0 on its API pages, but this CLI does not list them to this account, so they are not models of this listing.

calledNotListed.ownerDecision: «muse tambien tiene muse spark 1.3 que es infinitamente mas barato. Porque no se uso a nivel de haiku? considero que es un bug.» and «Dependiendo del effort muse spark 1.3 entra en nivel haiku o sonnet» (the owner, 2026-10-26).
